description: Six by six matrix mixer: any input can be pinned to any output, with cascading gain between the outputs

params.text: Pins that input into that output, adding it to the mix there at unity gain; pinning the same input to several outputs adds gain to it

inputs.text: One of the six signals the matrix distributes, DC coupled for audio or control voltage

outputs.text: Sums every input pinned to it, at unity gain
Sums every input pinned to it, and also takes the preceding output at a third of its level while that output is unpatched

notes: No input reaches any output until at least one pin is switched on
